input.command:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
import os, sys, io
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import click

@click.command()
@click.option('--name')
def cli(name):
    pass

os.environ['_TUPLE_PARAM_COMPLETE'] = 'zsh_source'
buf = io.StringIO()
old = sys.stdout
sys.stdout = buf
try:
    try:
        cli.main(prog_name='tuple-param', standalone_mode=True)
    except SystemExit:
        pass
finally:
    sys.stdout = old
print(repr(buf.getvalue()))
open('/tmp/gen2.zsh','w').write(buf.getvalue())
"
zsh -n /tmp/gen2.zsh && echo SYNTAX_OK
zsh /tmp/gen2.zsh; echo "RUN EXIT $?"
